name: AT-rich interaction domain 1A

function.text: ARID1A encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 1A. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler activity. It participates in transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Coffin-Siris syndrome (autosomal dominant); intellectual disability, autosomal dominant 14 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Urothelial carcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma; Hepatocellular carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
